name: audio-transcriber-for-raycast
title: Audio Transcriber for Raycast
description: Transcribe local audio/video files with speaker diarization
author: brianfrank

commands.name: transcribe
commands.title: Transcribe
commands.description: Transcribe a local audio or video file with speaker diarization

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: AssemblyAI API Key
preferences.description: Get one at assemblyai.com/dashboard. Not required if using Local Parakeet backend only.

preferences.name: defaultFormat
preferences.title: Default output format
preferences.description: Initial selection in the format dropdown

preferences.name: defaultKeyTerms
preferences.title: Default key terms
preferences.description: Comma-separated names/terms pre-filled into every transcription. Edit per-run in the form to override. AssemblyAI backend only — ignored by Local Parakeet.

preferences.name: transcriptionBackend
preferences.title: Transcription backend
preferences.description: AssemblyAI sends audio to the cloud. Local Parakeet runs on-device (Apple Silicon only).

preferences.name: parakeetBinaryPath
preferences.title: Parakeet binary path
preferences.description: Full path to the fluidaudiocli binary. Required when using Local Parakeet. See README for build instructions.
